notes.title: Gym Nights Devlog - Narrative
notes.content:
In this Devlog, I'll discuss how the narrative is integrated into the gameplay of Gym Nights.
You'll learn how the environment and story reflect the protagonist's subconscious, how exploration and night shifts as a guard reveal his inner fears, and about the hidden details and secrets that add depth and intrigue to the game.
